thread.title: Huawei’s Vice President Admitted Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s courage in implementing the notch on iPhone X

author: Douglas Bein
title: Huawei’s Vice President Admitted Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s courage in implementing the notch on iPhone X
text:
April 22, 2018 Huawei’s Vice President Admitted Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s courage in implementing the notch on iPhone X 
Huawei admitted that they were the first to design the notch 3 to 4 years ago, but Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) had the courage to go with it. 
This comes from the Huawei’s vice president Li Changzhu in a Forbes report, where he has stated that their firm had first designed the notch “three to four years ago” but refused to bring into the market or production. He said, ‘they believed that the market wasn’t ready for the drastic design diversity yet. Later, the company had decided to hold back because of the concerns of acceptance from users. 
The ‘notch’ is the most controversial design element in the world of smartphones, especially since the Apple’s iPhone X launch last year. 
“Consumers, especially those in China, like symmetry, and the notch is not perfect in Chinese culture. They like squares or circleslike rounded corners [of the display]. That’s perfect,” he said. 
He later admitted about Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s courage in implementing the notch on the iPhone X and even regretted in holding back of their initial invention.
